def solve(g):
    o=[row[:] for row in g]
    H=len(g); Wd=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

                o[a][b]=c
                a+=di; b+=dj
    return o
